description: This file defines a test utility class 'SliceFixture' used in integration testing with in-memory database setup, dependency injection, and mediation pattern for executing database operations and sending requests.

classes.name: SliceFixture
classes.description: A fixture class for setting up and tearing down in-memory database contexts for integration testing, with methods to execute scoped database actions and send requests via MediatR.

methods.name: SliceFixture
methods.description: Constructor that sets up dependency injection, in-memory database, and ensures database creation for testing.

methods.name: GetDbContext
methods.description: Retrieves the current ConduitContext instance from the service provider.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Deletes the in-memory database file created for testing.

methods.name: ExecuteScopeAsync
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous function within a created scope, passing in the IServiceProvider.

methods.name: SendAsync<TResponse>
methods.description: Sends a request via MediatR within a scope, returning the response.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Sends a request without expecting a response within a scope.

methods.name: ExecuteDbContextAsync
methods.description: Executes an action on the ConduitContext within a scope, returning a Task.

methods.name: ExecuteDbContextAsync<T>
methods.description: Executes an action on the ConduitContext within a scope, returning a result of type T.

methods.name: InsertAsync
methods.description: Inserts one or more entities into the database and saves changes asynchronously.
